correctness.rationale: The one-step inverse occurs iff the word contains ab bar(b) bar(a), exactly q² forbidden length-four factors. Inspected complete marked cluster shift table: only overlap lengths 3 (type A), 2 (one same-type), 1 (q successors). Two continuation equations eliminate to J(z)=1+z+2z²+(q+1)z³+qz⁴+qz⁵ and denominator 1-(q-1)z-(q-2)z²-(q-1)z³. The first six coefficients are consistent with inclusion/exclusion of length-four occurrences. A separate independently written last-three-symbol DP and formal series recurrence matched q=2,4,6 for n through 10; this is bounded corroboration, not the all-n proof. The 3×3 recurrence matrix for all even q≥2 is primitive (q=2 has q-2=0 yet remains strongly connected with a loop), so Perron–Frobenius gives unique dominant positive λ between q-1 and q and Θ_q(λ^n).

value.rationale: Counting locally irreversible roots is a natural exact language growth invariant for the DNA reverse-complement channel, not merely a coding bound. The uniform all-even-alphabet rational GF and entropy explicitly quantifies constrained words beyond the previously analyzed binary automaton; the proper result remains useful even if future higher-block classifications are open.

limitations: Locally irreducible means forbids one inverse deletion; it does not imply unique descendant root or an error-correcting code.
Alphabet must be even with fixed-point-free complement.
